provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: the 1862 opening word carried by an ornamental initial; the scan's recogniser loses it (target opens exaudi); recogniser damage, same word: target reads salutaris, the 1862 layer reads salut ris hi; recogniser damage, same word: target reads beate n uirginis tue festiuitate gaudemus, the 1862 layer reads be tee pudenti ne ufrginis tuse festiuit te gaude mus; recogniser damage, same word: target reads erudiamur, the 1862 layer reads erudi mur; conclusion length: the 1862 prints the short printed cue where the 1962 writes the conclusion out. Corroboration: 1922 Mame, artifact PDF p. 918 (printed p. 40* of the Commune Sanctorum); read from the page's word bounding boxes, reflowed column by column; reading: eae nos, Deus salutaris noster : ut, sicut de beate N. Virginis tue festivitate gaudémus; ita pie devotidnis erudiamur afféctu. Per Déminum.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Exaudi nos, Deus salutaris noster: ut sicut de beatae N. Virginis tuae
festivitate gaudemus; ita piae devotionis erudiamur affectu. Per Dominum
nostrum Jesum Christum.
